name: Uniswap New Pool Monitor Dashboard (Official Node)

parameters.content:
🚀 GETTING STARTED

This template monitors newly created Uniswap V3 pools on Base.

BEFORE RUNNING:
1. Create a Data Table named "new_pools_official" with these 14 columns:
   pool_address (String), token0_symbol (String), token0_address (String),
   token1_symbol (String), token1_address (String), fee_tier (String),
   liquidity (Number), volume_24h (Number), tx_count (Number),
   created_at (String), risk_score (Number), risk_level (String),
   risk_label (String), network (String)

2. Open the "Store New Pool" and "Get All Pools" nodes and select the new table.

3. Click "Execute Workflow" to test.

4. Publish the workflow, then access the dashboard at:
   /webhook/new-pools-dashboard

REQUIREMENTS:
- No API keys needed (uses free GeckoTerminal API)
- Base chain only

📊 DASHBOARD ACCESS

After publishing, access the live dashboard at:

http://YOUR_N8N_DOMAIN/webhook/new-pools-dashboard

The dashboard auto-refreshes every 30 seconds and shows:
- Total new pools (last 30)
- Risk distribution (Low/Medium/High/Critical)
- Pool details (liquidity, volume, tx count, risk score)

🧠 RISK SCORING LOGIC

Score is calculated based on:
- Liquidity: < $1K = +50, < $10K = +30, < $100K = +10
- 24h Volume: < $100 = +30, < $1K = +15
- Tx Count: < 10 = +20, < 100 = +10

Risk levels:
- 0-19: Low Risk
- 20-39: Medium Risk
- 40-59: High Risk
- 60+: Critical Risk
